sum: Turns text and real system sources into maintainable .drawio architecture models, syncs them incrementally without discarding manual layout, and enforces architecture contracts as a test in CI.
art: a .drawio model with a separate diagram intermediate representation (persistent)

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 2 of the 5 neutral interface standards (Agent Plugins, Agent Skills)
evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: local-first, the operator's state stays on their machine
evidence.se.threats: cites th and ctrl: T6 introduced, controls approval none, log part
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format diagram: a diagram source in an open text format
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec, ctrl and data_residency: the entry does not execute code itself and keeps its state local, so there is no unattended reach for a control to bound
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: Claude Code, Cursor (README.md)
evidence.ic.surface: Surface: none. Nothing is operated directly. The entry is read by an agent, which is a finding rather than a gap (README.md (npx skills add Agents365-ai/365-skills: a skill an agent loads, nothing a person operates))
evidence.fx.install: an install that does not change the machine globally: README.md (npx s)
evidence.fx.byo: the provider is the operator's choice: OLLAMA (README.md)

pre: a system whose structure is worth modelling
an agent that supports the Agent Skills format
anti: projects too small to carry an architecture model
teams that will not maintain the model once it exists
gnote: The one entry that emits a formal visual notation as its artifact, and it emits several: C4, UML, BPMN, ERD and flowcharts, from one intermediate representation. Architecture-as-test in CI makes the model a gate rather than a picture, which is the difference between a diagram that rots and one that fails a build.

ja.sum: 自然言語と実システムの情報から、保守できる .drawioのアーキテクチャモデルを作る。手で調整したレイアウトを壊さずに差分同期し、アーキテクチャの契約をCIのテストとして強制する。
ja.art: 意味と配置を分けた中間表現を持つ .drawioモデル（永続）
pre: 構造をモデル化する価値のあるシステム
Agent Skills形式に対応したエージェント
anti: アーキテクチャモデルを抱えるには小さすぎるプロジェクト
作った後にモデルを保守しないチーム
ja.gnote: 形式的な視覚記法を成果物として出力する唯一のツールであり、しかも複数出す。1つの中間表現からC4・UML・BPMN・ER図・フローチャートを投影する。CIでのアーキテクチャ・アズ・テストは、モデルを絵ではなくゲートにする。腐る図と、ビルドを落とす図の差である。
